contact_definitions.instantaneous: Equal mean of missing/expected feet per valid 10 ms snapshot; expected=0 omitted.
contact_definitions.cycle: Pool missing/expected samples within each nominal 1 s CPG cycle, then average cycle fractions.
contact_definitions.pooled: Total missing expected foot-time samples / total expected flat foot-time samples.

statistic_selection: Existing displacement-selected retained spawn sets exactly reused; no new omission or selection.
line_order: Increasing terrain height, not sorted by loss. No interpolation, smoothing or causal crosspoint fitting.
limitations: Complete-trial conditional means; especially height2.25 has large numerical failure fractions.
SD is across shared positions/headings on one terrain realization, not confidence intervals or independent terrain replicates.
Phase shifts count as missing support. A/B/C are descriptive equivalents, not fitted erasure probabilities.
Raw-count wave comparison uses different flat expected totals; C normalizes counts.

limitations: Means and SD are conditional on complete trials after the previously specified one-point omission; numerical/native/boundary failures are not zero displacement.
Pale bars are sample SD across shared positions/headings on one terrain realization, not confidence intervals or independent terrain replicates.
Wide 3-panel figures are readable at the original size; conversation thumbnails reduce the type size.
A/B/C are observed phase-matched support-pattern differences; they are not calibrated independent random-erasure probabilities.
Raw missing-sample totals use different flat expected-support denominators across waves; pooled C normalizes these counts.

independent_numeric_audit.scope: Existing committed 0–6 s scalar observations and summaries only. No raw NPZ reload, new physics, rendering or changed omission rule.

definitions.expected_support: 38-foot corresponding-wave flat contact mask at identical CPG clock, force >1e-8 N.
definitions.missing_support: Expected flat support AND absent rough support.
definitions.A_instantaneous: For every 10 ms time with at least one flat contact, missing foot count / expected flat foot count; average valid time fractions equally.
definitions.B_cycle: Within each nominal 1 s CPG cycle, sum missing foot-time samples / sum expected foot-time samples, then average six cycle fractions equally.
definitions.C_pooled: Whole-window missing foot-time sample total / whole-window expected flat foot-time sample total.
definitions.missing_samples_count: Count missing expected individual-foot support samples over all600 sampled times t=0.01..6.00 s. Unit is foot-time samples, not number of times or simulated erasures.

reuse_instructions: Use each summary exact retained spawn_indices, select matching cutoff_mm,height_scale,wave cells, and read missing_samples. Do not apply another omission on the count axis.
Calculate missing count mean and sample SD over those same retained cells, and pair with the existing forward_0_6_mm mean/SD. No physics or contact replay is required.
Equivalently, because E_wave is constant for every trial in a wave, count_mean=C_percent_mean*E_wave/100 and count_SD=C_percent_SD*E_wave/100. This conversion cannot be applied to A or B.
For roughness versus loss, use the fixed 38-foot/703-pair angle RMS shared by all waves at each physical terrain; separate2/4/8 mm panels as requested.
Include each existing flat control once per wave at roughness0, loss0, missing_count0, same point style. There is no repeat-based flat SD.
limitations: All axes must use the same0–6 s window and retained observations. The stopping rule uses raw4–6 s separately.
Different waves have different expected flat foot-time totals. A count-axis crosspoint partly reflects expected-support capacity; normalized C removes this whole-window denominator difference.
The count axis is a descriptive flat-referenced contact-pattern difference, not the probability of independent contact erasure. A/B/C differ in temporal weighting.
Same CPG clock does not guarantee identical realized contact phase; phase shifts contribute to missing-support measurements.
Group means are conditional on complete validated trajectories; failures have no displacement/contact score and are not zero.
At height2.25 retained n ranges7..21 by group. Pale error bars should mean sample SD, not standard error or confidence intervals.
Wave-specific loss curves can cross at loss values produced by different terrain roughness. Such crossing is not necessarily a same-terrain causal comparison.

observations: At equal roughness, wave1.5 has the highest observed A loss; wave3.5 usually the lowest.
Using contact-loss fraction as x-coordinate brings several intermediate-loss displacement curves closer, without full collapse or established causal attribution.
